remarks: Spacious and updated tri-level townhouse in well maintained complex. Over 2000 square feet of finished living space with 2 Bedrooms and 3 Full Bathrooms. Updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances. Freshly painted & Hardwood flooring throughout. Open floor plan with family room with vaulted ceiling, fireplace and sliders leading to outdoor balcony - perfect for entertaining. Primary bedroom suite with vaulted ceilings, full bath and private deck. An additional bedroom with vaulted ceiling and updated bathroom in hall. Fully finished walk-out lower level with full bathroom and sauna. Plenty of storage as well. New Washer & New Dryer. New Blinds. 1 Reserved space adjacent to the rental. Complex is a desirable, well-managed community of 48 townhomes offering an exceptional location just minutes from downtown Stamford and 2 Metro-North train stations - Stamford downtown and Glenbrook, making it ideal for commuters. Residents enjoy a beautifully maintained in-ground pool, a newly renovated playground, and ample guest parking. The complex is pet-friendly and surrounded by beautifully manicured grounds. With easy access to shopping, dining, parks, and major highways, Hillandale combines comfort, convenience, and a vibrant community atmosphere.
